states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.ionDriveSpinning === true && window.__3D_STATE__.beamActive === true && window.__3D_STATE__.particleCount > 0

states.name: Dominant Channel Set

states.name: Shader Effects Applied

states.name: Stable Operation
states.description: System running with consistent energy conservation and visual effects for extended period
states.condition: window.__3D_STATE__ && window.__3D_STATE__.scanLines >= 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.heatDistortion >= 0 && window.__3D_STATE__.refraction >= 0 && Math.abs(window.__3D_STATE__.totalEnergy - 300) < 0.01 && window.__3D_STATE__.beamActive === true
